text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (It hurts! It hurts! 2,400 meters... is so, so long...! And besides—)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(—I can feel her footsteps, her breathing!
My legs are trembling... but...!)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I ab... solutely!
Won't back down...!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"The Oaks is... mine!!
AAAHHHHHHHHHHHH...!!!!"

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Haa...! Haa...!
Haa...! Haa...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (Waaah...!!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, Verxinaaa!
You are the new Queen of the Oaks!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I did it...! *pant*...!
The stronger one... was me...!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: (Were you watching!? The strongest one right now isn't you, it's ME—)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
—...Yes.
I suppose that was the reason for my defeat.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ...Ngh... Phew...

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"……Defeat.
I have received this humiliation loud and clear."

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
"Let us proceed with preparations for the Shuka Sho.
—We shall hone your strength even further."

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Big sis, you were amazing, amazing!
—You actually beat Gentildonna!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentile was crazy strong~!
And yet... it still kinda looks like she wasn't even breaking a sweat?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"Yeah... Her breathing has already settled back to normal.
Her baseline physical ability really must be incredible..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
If I had a rival like that...
...it'd send chills down my spine.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
(Gentil-san...
What a magnificent, imposing figure――)

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Hk, phew...
I have to... get stronger... even stronger...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Still, how?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Having exhausted all her strength, Verxina was tremendously fatigued. So, after taking a short break and letting her calm down, once again—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations~~, Big Sis!
You're incredible, a true queen...—

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
...Wait, are you okay?
Still tired? Take it easy and sit down, okay?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...No, I'm alright.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
How pathetic of me.
Even though she seemed completely fine.

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Why'd you say that!?
You were super cool too, Onee-chan~♡

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
I need to...
grow so much, much more.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
"At this rate,
she might not be able to win the Shuka Sho."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
W-Why...?
Big sister won today, and yet...

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Yes. I won today.
But what about tomorrow? And what about the future...?

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: I must remain stronger than her, or I cannot hold onto the summit!
choice_data_list: ...I heard your feelings loud and clear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Desiring dramatic growth greater than ever before...
For Verxina, an opportunity second to none was right before her eyes.
choice_data_list: Let's push ourselves to the limit at summer camp!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The annual summer training camp held to sharpen the Umamusume's
abilities... There, they show tremendous growth.
However, that meant—

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
That means Ms. Gentile will become
even stronger as well... doesn't it?

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
B-But... you never know, right?
Maybe big sis can get a whole lot stronger!

text_block_list.name: Vivlos
text_block_list.text:
Let's celebrate today!
We won, after all!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you, Vivlos.
Yes, for now... this is fine.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text:
Trainer.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: In the next Shuka Sho, I want to achieve a victory so flawless... so absolute that it erases her completely from my heart.

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Please—forge me to my absolute limits!
